name: ai_marketing_claude
description: An AI-powered marketing toolkit offering 15 distinct marketing skills with parallel subagents to audit websites, generate marketing copy, email sequences, ad campaigns, content calendars, competitive intelligence, and client-ready PDF reports.

inputs.name: website_url
inputs.description: URL of the website to audit or analyze.

inputs.name: marketing_objective
inputs.description: The goal or focus of the marketing campaign or content.

inputs.name: target_audience
inputs.description: Description or demographic information about the intended audience.

inputs.name: copy_requirements
inputs.description: Details or style preferences for generating marketing copy.

inputs.name: email_sequence_parameters
inputs.description: Details defining number of emails, sequence type, and desired tone.

inputs.name: ad_campaign_details
inputs.description: Information about campaign goals, budget, platforms, and creatives.

inputs.name: content_calendar_preferences
inputs.description: Scheduling preferences and content topics for calendar generation.

inputs.name: competitive_intel_targets
inputs.description: Competitors or market segments to analyze for intelligence gathering.

outputs.name: website_audit_report
outputs.description: Comprehensive report highlighting strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities of the audited website.

outputs.name: marketing_copy
outputs.description: Generated marketing text tailored to the specified requirements.

outputs.name: email_sequence
outputs.description: Series of crafted emails formatted for campaign use.

outputs.name: ad_campaign_plan
outputs.description: Detailed campaign structure and creative recommendations.

outputs.name: content_calendar
outputs.description: Scheduled content plan with dates and topics.

outputs.name: competitive_intelligence_report
outputs.description: Analysis summary of competitors’ marketing strategies.

outputs.name: client_ready_report
outputs.description: Professional PDF report compiling all relevant marketing insights and outputs.

steps: Receive and parse input parameters including website URL and marketing objectives
Distribute tasks to specialized parallel subagents for audits, copywriting, email sequences, ad campaigns, etc.
Each subagent executes its designated marketing skill leveraging AI models
Aggregate outputs from all subagents into structured formats
Generate client-ready PDF reports compiling insights and marketing assets
Deliver final outputs for user review and deployment
use_cases: Marketing agencies needing automated, comprehensive campaign planning and execution
Businesses performing competitor analysis and website audits to improve marketing strategies
Content creators generating multi-channel marketing content rapidly
Email marketers designing complex drip campaigns with AI assistance
Consultants preparing professional marketing reports for clients
patterns: Parallel subagent coordination for simultaneous marketing skill execution
Template-driven prompt engineering for diverse marketing content generation
Automated website auditing and report generation workflow
Modular content creation pipelines for multi-channel marketing assets
Data aggregation and synthesis for competitive intelligence

prompt_templates.name: website_audit_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Audit the website at {website_url} and generate a detailed report on SEO, UX, content quality, and competitor comparison.

prompt_templates.name: copy_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate marketing copy focused on {marketing_objective} for {target_audience} using this style: {copy_requirements}.

prompt_templates.name: email_sequence_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create an email sequence of {email_count} emails with tone {tone} targeted at {target_audience} for the campaign objective: {marketing_objective}.

prompt_templates.name: ad_campaign_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Design an ad campaign plan with budget {budget} and platforms {platforms} focused on {marketing_objective}.

prompt_templates.name: content_calendar_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a content calendar for {period} focusing on topics: {topics} with publishing frequency {frequency}.

prompt_templates.name: competitive_intelligence_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Analyze competitors {competitive_intel_targets} and provide insights on their marketing strategies.
